messages:
Ellen: Quick follow-up after the token-validation hiccup. Need owners for rotation, perms cleanup, audit-log gap, and a recurring detection plan. Keep replies short.
Ravi: I can own rotation. Proposal: rotate critical machine tokens (ci-runner, deployer) first, then 72h sweep. Staged canary in namespace `alpha-deploy`. ETA: critical in 36h.
Kat: I'll run the permissions tidy. Plan: snapshot IAM + k8s bindings, run diff tool, and open remediation PRs with canary namespace gating. ETA: 4 business days.
Diego: I'll investigate missing audit entries. Hypothesis: log-mothership filter + consumer lag. I'll enable 12h sampling and replay proxy traces. ETA: 18-24h for root cause and hotfix.
Mira (infra): If sampling is on, I'll add autoscale rules for the forwarder and a short retention change to limit S3 burst. Alert to #eng-infra if shipper_disk > 75% for 30m.
sec-bot: Created SEC-1202: 'token-validation follow-up' assigned to Ellen. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-1202
Ellen: Added tiny validation steps to SEC-1202: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEW" https://auth.redwood.internal/introspect | jq .active` -> expect `true`; old tokens should 401 or `false`.
Ravi: Rotation steps (summary): 1) create new token; 2) stage in alpha-deploy; 3) run introspect smoke; 4) roll by waves; 5) revoke old after 24h guard window. Will include rollback key in SEC-1202.
Kat: Perms commands I'll use: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > iam.json` and `kubectl get rolebinding -A -o json`. I'll post CSV of principals->services to ENG-6010.
Diego: Forwarder override snippet (temp): `filters:\n  include: [event: token.introspect, level: info]` I'll paste samples into SEC-1202.
Mira (infra): Adding an ops metric for token-introspect latency during rotation windows to /ops/health. Also autoscale rule in place now.
Ellen: Recurring detection proposal: daily audit-ingest healthcheck, weekly token smoke (exchange + introspect), monthly perms diff with auto-ticket if >5% drift. Who can own weekly smoke?
Ravi: I'll wire the weekly smoke runner and publish results to /ops/health with pass/fail + last_run.
Kat: For perms diffs I'll create baseline in ENG-6010 and schedule monthly diffs; auto-open ENG tickets on significant drift.
Ellen: Action summary: Ravi -> rotate critical tokens (36h) + weekly smoke; Kat -> perms audit + baseline (4d); Diego -> audit sampling + fix (24h); Mira -> infra safeguards (now). Review meeting in 3 business days. Put PR links & runbook snippets into SEC-1202. This thread is canonical for owners/timelines.
